explanation: The LiveKit Google plugin (realtime_api.py) supports usage_metadata event handling, but the headless batch audio recorder script (batch_infer.py) did not persist RealtimeModelMetrics into the output result.json files. Therefore, exact provider-reported tokens were not captured for this run.

estimated_usage_from_audio_duration.methodology: Calculated from measured average audio durations using official Gemini native audio rate of ~32 tokens/second
